task: E3 Phase 1 — DECAF Component A: position-disentangled store (Gate 1)

design.store: pre-RoPE K + V per 196-token frame block on CPU (STOCK ReKV already stores pre-RoPE keys; audit finding, trap-checked T1) + explicit int64 position sidecar per block (block_starts, 8B/block/layer-manager)
design.retrieval: content-key scoring UNCHANGED (stock: pre-RoPE mean-pooled block keys vs pre-RoPE question query); retrieval-recall deltas arise because layer>=1 query embeddings evolve under different attention geometry
design.rotate_on_fetch: retrieved blocks rotated to EXACT original positions from sidecar (n_init + b*196 + j); init tokens 0..12 (stock-identical); question + decode tokens at true streaming positions (next_pos = store length at query)
design.memory: store bytes identical to entangled (fp16 K/V, same shapes); sidecar = n_blocks*8B*24 layer-managers (negligible); reported per run from calc_memory_usage_detailed

arms.entangled_baseline: W2.5 runs/20260926_1455_w25_judge_harness (0.5B 45.5/2.36, 7B 54.1/2.82, 72B-judged, n=1465) + new entangled RECALL-ONLY passes (DECAF_RECALL_ONLY=1, flag off)
arms.position_free: new answering runs, DECAF_POSITION_FREE=1, same config as W2.5

config: rekv_stream_vqa, sample_fps 0.5, n_local 15000, retrieve_size 64, chunk_size 1, internal retrieval, greedy, seed 2024; models llava-onevision-qwen2-{0.5b,7b}-ov-hf; data data/rvs/ego/ego4d_oe.json (10 videos x 1h, 1465 Qs)
gate1: retrieval recall +>=5 pts OR RVS-Ego Acc +>=2 pts (72B-judged) vs entangled at equal memory
recall_oracle: per question window [start_time,end_time] in ego4d_oe.json at 0.5 fps: relevant blocks = frames b with start*0.5 <= b < end*0.5, restricted to blocks encoded at query time; micro + macro recall on layer-0 retrieved blocks; relaxed variant expands window by +-30s
